title: Growing tomatoes in home gardens
scope: University of Minnesota crop-level outdoor tomato guidance on full sun, warm/frost-free growing, growth-habit distinctions, soil moisture, harvest, crop rotation and common issues; Minnesota calendars, field spacing and soil watering quantities are not cultivar-specific or indoor/hydroponic prescriptions

title: Tomato disorders
scope: University of Minnesota diagnostic guidance on tomato physiological disorders including blossom-end rot, cracking and sunscald; larger slicer types are reported more prone to blossom-end rot than cherry types, but this is a relative crop-type observation, not cultivar-specific resistance or diagnosis

title: Tomato leaf spot diseases
scope: University of Minnesota crop-level tomato disease-prevention and recognition guidance for home gardens, including leaf wetness, sanitation and support; regional disease prevalence is not transferred as universal cultivar susceptibility or resistance

title: Growing peppers in home gardens
scope: University of Minnesota crop-level Capsicum guidance for outdoor garden cultivation, moisture, harvest, visible disorders and hot-pepper handling; temperature and climate notes are Minnesota context, not cultivar-specific dimensions, disease resistance, universal calendars, indoor settings or hydroponic values

title: Growing lettuce, endive and radicchio in home gardens
scope: Minnesota Extension crop-level lettuce guidance on cool-season growth, shallow-root moisture, bolting, harvest and disorders; variety-specific heat tolerance, cultivar dimensions, universal calendars and hydroponic values are not inferred

title: 2019 Summer Lettuce Variety Trial Results
scope: One reported 2019 summer lettuce variety trial; Bronze Arrow's recorded weight, disease score, taste/bitterness ratings and bolting count apply only to that trial and are not a universal cultivar guarantee

title: Growing radishes in home gardens
scope: Minnesota Extension garden-radish crop guidance on cool conditions, soil preparation, moisture, harvest quality, cracking and pests; recommendations for other radish types, local calendar and cultivar-specific timing are not transferred

title: Growing dill in home gardens
scope: Species-level Anethum graveolens cultivation and established-plant care, foliage and seed harvest, annual habit, light and support in Minnesota; no Bouquet-specific dimensions or seed-starting protocol is generalized

title: Growing Herbs in the Garden
scope: Penn State Extension general Mediterranean-herb guidance explicitly including Salvia officinalis and Thymus vulgaris: full sun, well-drained dry/gravelly soil and home-garden context; not indoor or hydroponic parameters and not named-cultivar performance

title: Growing herbs in home gardens
scope: Minnesota Extension herb-family guidance on light, drainage, watering and group-level growth habits; statements about Lamiaceae or Apiaceae are not cultivar-specific

title: Growing basil in home gardens
scope: Species-level common/sweet basil identity, light, drainage, annual growth, pruning, harvest and regional downy-mildew context; cultivar-specific dimensions and disease resistance are not inferred

title: Growing chives in home gardens
scope: Species-level Allium schoenoprasum habit, outdoor/container light and drainage, division, watering and harvest guidance; does not describe garlic chives or another cultivar

title: Growing parsley in home gardens
scope: Species-level Petroselinum crispum cultivation and harvest in Minnesota, including biennial lifecycle and stem-cutting method; no Italian Giant cultivar-specific performance claims

title: Rosemary
scope: Species-level rosemary habit, regional hardiness, well-drained soil, full sun, young-plant pinching and leaf harvest; source uses the synonym Rosmarinus officinalis and gives regional rather than universal overwintering context

title: Onions (Bunching)
scope: Crop-type guidance for bunching onions: outdoor light, soil moisture, container context, common pest/disease watch list and harvest; Oregon calendar and soil spacing are not converted to universal or hydroponic rules and do not establish Nabuka-specific traits

title: Growing beans in home gardens
scope: University of Minnesota Extension outdoor home-garden guidance for Phaseolus vulgaris bean uses and growth habits, plus separately identified lima, fava and other beans; Minnesota climate, soil, field spacing and variety examples remain regional/crop-level and do not establish unlisted cultivar traits or indoor/hydroponic settings

title: Growing peas in home gardens
scope: University of Minnesota Extension outdoor home-garden guidance for Pisum sativum shelling, snow and sugar-snap pea types, cool-season response, support distinctions, moisture and harvest cues; Minnesota timing and soil spacing are not cultivar-specific or indoor/hydroponic prescriptions

title: Growing cucumbers in home gardens
scope: Cucumis sativus crop-level outdoor home-garden guidance on vining versus bush types, flowering and pollination, moisture, harvest, bitterness and disease-aware handling; Minnesota calendars, soil row spacing and watering quantities are not cultivar-specific or indoor/hydroponic prescriptions

title: Downy mildew of cucumber, melon and squash
scope: Recognition and regional disease context for downy mildew across cucurbits; disease pressure and timing are regional and seasonal, symptoms can resemble other disorders, and this source does not establish cultivar resistance or a diagnosis for an individual plant

title: Growing summer squash and zucchini in home gardens
scope: Cucurbita pepo summer-squash crop-type outdoor guidance explicitly including zucchini and pattypan: warm-season growth, bush versus vining forms, pollination, soil moisture, harvest maturity and visible pest/disease issues; Minnesota calendars, row spacing and watering quantities are not cultivar-specific or hydroponic prescriptions

title: How to Grow Cantaloupe (Muskmelon) in Your Garden
scope: USU Extension crop-level outdoor cantaloupe guidance on vining growth, pollination, moisture, trellising with fruit support, maturity cues and common problems; Utah climate and field-spacing recommendations are not cultivar-specific or hydroponic prescriptions

title: How to Grow Watermelon in Your Garden
scope: USU Extension crop-level outdoor watermelon guidance on vining growth, moisture, pollination context, maturity indicators and common problems; Utah climate and field-spacing recommendations are not Sugar Baby-specific or hydroponic prescriptions

title: Harvesting and storing melons, squash and pumpkins
scope: Postharvest maturity and handling guidance for melon, winter squash and pumpkin crop groups, including rind/stem maturity cues and harvest technique; commercial/postharvest context does not establish cultivar-specific growing dimensions, calendars or hydroponic practices

title: Armenian Cucumber: A Warm Season Crop to Try
scope: UF/IFAS Extension demonstration and crop-type evidence identifying Armenian cucumber as Cucumis melo var. flexuosus rather than C. sativus and describing its long, thin-skinned fruit and local trial observations; Florida timing and trial outcomes are not universal cultivar or hydroponic prescriptions

title: Growing broccoli in home gardens
scope: UMN home-garden guidance for heading broccoli: cool-season growth, moisture, tight green flower-bud harvest and secondary side shoots after central-head removal; Minnesota timing and field spacing are not cultivar-specific or indoor/hydroponic prescriptions

title: Growing Brussels sprouts in home gardens
scope: UMN home-garden crop/type guidance for Brussels sprouts on a tall stalk, bottom-up sprout development, moisture-sensitive quality, topping and harvest; Minnesota seasonal and frost notes are regional and do not establish named-cultivar dimensions or indoor/hydroponic practices

title: Growing kohlrabi in home gardens
scope: UMN home-garden guidance for Brassica oleracea kohlrabi: enlarged above-ground stem, cool conditions, steady soil moisture, edible leaves and harvest quality; Minnesota dates, soil distances and 2–3 inch size cue are regional crop guidance, not cultivar or hydroponic settings

title: Growing Chinese cabbage and bok choy in home gardens
scope: UMN home-garden guidance for Chinese/Napa cabbage and bok choy, distinguishing Brassica rapa pekinensis barrel-shaped heads from B. rapa chinensis leafy stalks; continuous moisture, seasonal bolting and head formation are crop/type guidance, while Minnesota sowing dates and distances are regional and not hydroponic prescriptions

publisher: UC Master Gardener Program of Sonoma County
title: Rapini (Broccoli Raab)
scope: UC Master Gardener crop/type profile identifying rapini/broccoli raab with Brassica rapa var. rapa and describing cool-season growth, heat-related bolting, edible buds/leaves/stems and harvest before buds open; Sonoma County calendar, height and spacing are regional, not a cultivar or hydroponic prescription

title: Growing cool-season crops
scope: UMN regional explanation of temperature-related development in cool-season vegetables including brassicas: bolting, head formation and buttoning; timing and temperature examples reflect Minnesota conditions and are not cultivar-specific calendars

title: Irrigation strategies for vegetables
scope: UMN crop-level irrigation principles and critical water periods; broccoli, cabbage and cauliflower head development is a critical period, but quantities and commercial production examples are not individualized cultivar or indoor-system recommendations

title: Harvesting and storing home garden vegetables
scope: UMN home-garden postharvest recommendations for commonly grown crops, including broccoli harvest while flower buds remain tight and green; regional storage life is approximate and not a cultivar-specific maturity calendar

title: Asian Greens — Key Growing Information
scope: Commercial grower guide distinguishing budding/cutting choy sum and kailaan from heading types including komatsuna; seasonal sowing, succession, flea-beetle row-cover guidance and harvest stages are crop-group production guidance, not cultivar-specific or hydroponic instructions

title: Brassica rapa var. rosularis (Flat Cabbage, Rosette Pak Choi, Tat Soi)
